title: Mentee momentum + 1:1 prep — Omar Ali
body:
Quick context:
- Omar joined infra team 10 months ago. Strong on debugging, recently picked up grpc proxy work. Wants to move toward backend-systems (L7) ownership.
- Current sprint: service migration for kv-cache (ENG-4821) — task split between Omar (proxy/adapter) and Priya (integration tests).
- Last 1:1 notes (5/29): asked for clearer path to staff IC, asked for public speaking opps, wanted feedback on code reviews.

Meeting goals (30 min):
1) Surface immediate blockers and unblock the migration tasks.
2) Agree on 2 measurable outcomes for next 6 weeks (impact + signals).
3) Career touchpoint: clarify "ownership" steps and quick wins for visibility.
4) Action planning and commit on next follow-ups (who/when).

Agenda (tight):
- 0-5m check-in (mood, context) — ask: "What's taking most of your mental bandwidth this week?"
- 5-12m blockers: kv-cache migration, docker image flakiness in canary, flaky e2e test STEP-7
- 12-20m career & visibility: define 2 short projects to own (metric + external signal)
- 20-28m feedback loop: how are reviews going? pairing requests?
- 28-30m actions + scheduling follow-ups

Notes / prompts to use live:
- "When you think about stepping up, which pieces excite you: design, cross-team negotiation, or deep perf work?"
- "If we could ship one thing in 6 weeks that shows staff-level impact, what would it be?"
- Signal examples: owning a release, leading postmortem, owning a cross-team API, public talk or internal demo.

Known blockers (to confirm):
- ENV: docker images sometimes timeout on our CI runners (repro on node-12) — Omar mentioned seeing build timeouts daily.
- DEP: missing feature flag toggle in staging prevents canary (ticket ENG-4867, assigned to infra-ops).
- TEST: flaky e2e STEP-7 (timeout) — suggested short-term retry in test harness (quick fix) vs longer flake root-cause.

Suggested short tactical moves (can propose during 1:1):
- Reproduce docker timeout locally with the small runner script (ask Omar to try node-12 snapshot + attach logs) — quick blocker resolution.
- Add a temporary test harness retry for STEP-7 and create follow-up refactor ticket.
- I will escalate ENG-4867 at standup if no triage by EOD Fri.

Career / growth plan (concrete proposals):
1) Ownership project: "Cache adapter hardening" — 6-week scope: own design doc, define SLO targets, ship canary + rollback plan, present in Eng All-Hands. Success signals: canary latency improves 10–15%, zero production errors in 2 canaries.
2) Visibility play: lead 10-minute demo at next Eng Lunch (I'll book slot). Also co-author a short postmortem or migration write-up for the engineering blog.
3) Mentorship: pair Omar with Priya for integration tests and with Samir for routing/rollout playbooks.

Concrete outcomes to propose & confirm (pick 2):
- Outcome A (impact): Ship cache adapter canary with rollback policy by 2027-07-24.
- Outcome B (signal): Present migration overview at Eng Lunch on 2027-07-12.
- Outcome C (process): Reduce STEP-7 flakiness to <2% by adding harness retry + refactor ticket.

Feedback I want to give (keep it short):
- Strengths: very pragmatic, strong ownership on debugging, communicates clearly in async.
- Area to nudge: prioritize design artifacts earlier (sketches, tradeoffs) so cross-team reviews go faster.
- Practical tip: create a one-pager outlining the canary rollback matrix — helps partner teams say yes faster.

Open questions to ask Omar:
- Are you comfortable leading stakeholder syncs for the canary (opt-in: 1 upstream product owner + infra)?
- Which of the three outcomes above feels most motivating?
- Do you want me to escalate resource constraints or do you prefer to prototype a stopgap?

Action items (owner / due):
- Omar: reproduce docker timeout locally and paste logs into ENG-4821 comments (due: 2027-06-14).
- Riya (me): escalate ENG-4867 at tomorrow infra standup and ping infra-ops (due: 2027-06-13).
- Omar + Priya: add short-term retry to STEP-7 and open refactor ticket (ticket: ENG-4906) (due: 2027-06-18).
- Riya: book Eng Lunch demo slot for 2027-07-12 and draft intro email (due: 2027-06-16).
- Omar: draft 1-page canary rollback matrix and share for review (due: 2027-06-21).

Notes to self (manager prep):
- Keep tone coaching, not prescriptive. Offer to remove noise (escalate) rather than solve patches unless he asks.
- Push him toward ownership by asking what he'd delegate, not micromanage.
- Remember to call out recent win on PR #1342 — reinforce positive behavior.

Follow-up cadence: quick 15m sync in 2 weeks to check progress on reproducer + canary doc (propose 2027-06-28).

Rough drafts / snippets to paste in convo: 
- "If you can get a reproducible log for the docker timeout today, I’ll escalate and we’ll aim to unblock CI by EOD tomorrow."
- "Two outcomes for the next 6 weeks: ship a safe canary (impact) and present findings publicly (visibility). Which two do you pick?"

Random scratch ideas (not for the meeting unless Omar wants to brainstorm):
- Side project: internal lint rule to block image tag wildcards — could prevent future flakiness.
- Lightweight perf harness that fuzzes concurrency for kv-cache adapter (team hack-week candidate).

End of doc.
